ingredients.name: Whole Wheat Flour
ingredients.description: The whole grain, bran and all. It is what gives the cookie its colour, its density and the slightly rough crumb you can see at the break.
benefits: The whole grain, nothing stripped out

ingredients.name: Palm Jaggery
ingredients.description: Reduced from palm sap rather than refined from cane. It is what makes the cookie taste of caramel and toffee rather than of plain sweetness.
benefits: Unrefined, so it keeps its colour
Not sugar-free — it is still sugar

ingredients.name: Desi Ghee
ingredients.description: Clarified butter, and the only fat in the recipe. No palm oil, no vanaspati, no refined oil of any kind.

ingredients.name: Besan (Gram Flour)
ingredients.description: Stone-ground chickpea flour that gives the cookie its body and a gently nutty, roasted note.

ingredients.name: Dry Coconut
ingredients.description: Dried coconut, folded through the dough. It is the texture you notice second, after the snap.

ingredients.name: Fennel Seeds
ingredients.description: Saunf — the note most people cannot place on the first bite and recognise instantly on the second.
benefits: A very old pairing with jaggery
